[[File:StealthShip-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|The Republic prototype stealth ship]]
'''Stealth ships''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitted with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] or other stealth technology. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fielded [[Stealth ship (Galactic Republic)/Legends|one such ship]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse">{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}}</ref>
